ratified: 2026-08-03 — founder-approved editorial-ambition package; concept pre-existed in the corpus
canonicalExplanation: A recording is not a feature — it is an artifact. The tape exists on a server the rep doesn't control, can be replayed, subpoenaed, or discovered, and outlives the conversation it captured. Swapping vendors doesn't remove the tape; only not making one does.
avoidWhen: contexts where recording is genuinely required by the customer's compliance regime
